items.back: Founded 24 Oct 1945; HQ New York; 193 members; 6 organs (UNGA, UNSC, ECOSOC, Secretariat, ICJ, Trusteeship Council – suspended 1994).
15 = 5 permanent (US, UK, France, Russia, China, with veto) + 10 non-permanent (2-yr). ICJ = The Hague, 15 judges.
IMF & World Bank, created 1944, HQ Washington DC. IMF MD European by convention (Kristalina Georgieva); WB President American (Ajay Banga).
IBRD, IDA (=World Bank), IFC (private sector; Masala bonds), MIGA (guarantees), ICSID (disputes; India not a member).
Replaced GATT on 1 Jan 1995; HQ Geneva; ~166 members; binding dispute settlement; DG Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala.
ADB (1966, Manila, Japanese head); AIIB (2016, Beijing); NDB (BRICS, Shanghai, Dilma Rousseff). India is a founding member of all three.
HDR = UNDP; World Investment Report = UNCTAD; Global Competitiveness Report = WEF (non-UN); GFSR & WEO = IMF; World Development Report = World Bank.
items.examPoint: Reports-to-body matching — HDR/UNDP, WIR/UNCTAD, GCR/WEF, GFSR-WEO/IMF

items.back: Member: UN, IMF, World Bank, WTO, ADB, AIIB (2nd-largest shareholder), NDB. NOT a member: OECD, OPEC.
items.examPoint: India's membership — not OECD or OPEC

items.back: Vienna: IAEA, OPEC, UNIDO, CTBTO. Geneva: WHO, ILO, WTO, WMO, WIPO. Rome: FAO. Nairobi: UNEP. The Hague: ICJ & ICC.
items.examPoint: Agency HQ locations (Vienna = IAEA & OPEC etc.)
